contract.costs:
Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.
r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.
r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.

contract.requires:
C is known square-integrable at controller and final predictor; V~N(0,I) independent of C, physical iid Gaussian read noise and all algorithmic seeds. Feasible unit-ball scalar linear rows, arbitrary repeated/oblique designs, legal predictable transcripts.
Hard q reads and B binary controller branches per path, totalized counterfactual replay. Timing, addresses, requests, stopping and metadata that distinguish C-dependent actuator behavior are charged. Correlated public context requires conditional codebooks; actuator-only predictor lacking C is different.
Hermite target uses supplied context/response split, degree p, normalized basis and known/acquired coefficients, independent Gaussian U,V. Finite calibration error, numerical law and model L2 adequacy must actually be acquired under the stated same sensing law.
